verdict.rationale: Canny's MCP server lets an LLM query feedback, understand context, and update statuses/organize requests, which implies some structuring of feedback into actionable items, but there's no evidence of a dedicated feature that takes a plain-language description and outputs a structured set of proposed tasks. missing for 10: explicit task/proposal generation from freeform text, structured output format (e.g., ticket/task list), independent or hands-on confirmation of this specific workflow.
